label: Sentry
description: Errors, issues, releases of your applications
agentGuide: Base path /api/0; paths end with a slash. Organizations: GET /api/0/organizations/; projects: GET /api/0/organizations/<org>/projects/. Issues: GET /api/0/projects/<org>/<project>/issues/?query=is:unresolved&sort=freq (title, count, userCount, lastSeen, permalink); one: GET /api/0/issues/<id>/; its latest event with the stack trace: GET /api/0/issues/<id>/events/latest/. Resolve or ignore: PUT /api/0/issues/<id>/ {"status": "resolved"}. Releases: GET /api/0/organizations/<org>/releases/. Stats: GET /api/0/organizations/<org>/stats_v2/?field=sum(quantity)&statsPeriod=24h&groupBy=category. Events are large: read the issue list first, one event only when needed. The token is set by Allkin.
